name: External reset password
description: Redirects the Drupal user password-reset request form to an administrator-configured external URL.
project_description: The External Reset Password module lets an administrator configure an external URL that the Drupal user password-reset request page redirects to. When a visitor opens the built-in "Request new password" form (route user.pass at /user/password), a kernel-request event subscriber (ExternalRedirectSubscriber) issues a redirect to the configured URL instead of rendering Drupal's own form. This suits sites whose authentication or password management lives in an external system (identity provider, SSO portal, or a custom reset page). The whole module is a single settings form (ErpSettingsForm, route external_reset_password.settings_form under /admin/config/people, gated by the core 'administer site configuration' permission) that stores one value, the 'url' key of the external_reset_password.settings config object, plus the event subscriber that acts on it. It ships config schema but no permissions, entities, plugins, services beyond the subscriber, or Drush commands, and depends only on core's User module.
